| Input | `vehicleSpeedSensorInputPin` | choice |  | https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~event_inputs |
| Filter parameter | `vssFilterReciprocal` |  | 3 … 200 | Set this so your vehicle speed signal is responsive, but not noisy. Larger value give smoother but slower response. |
| Wheel revolutions per kilometer | `driveWheelRevPerKm` | revs/km | 100 … 1000 | Number of revolutions per kilometer for the wheels your vehicle speed sensor is connected to. Use an online calculator to determine this based on your tire size. |
| Speed sensor gear ratio | `vssGearRatio` | ratio | 0 … 60 | Number of turns of your vehicle speed sensor per turn of the wheels. For example if your sensor is on the transmission output, enter your axle/differential ratio. If you are using a hub-mounted sensor, enter a value of 1.0. |
| Speed sensor tooth count | `vssToothCount` | count | 1 … 100 | Number of pulses output per revolution of the shaft where your VSS is mounted. For example, GM applications of the T56 output 17 pulses per revolution of the transmission output shaft. |
| Enable CAN VSS | `enableCanVss` | choice |  | Read VSS from OEM CAN bus according to selected CAN vehicle configuration. |
| CAN VSS type | `canVssNbcType` | choice |  |  |
| CAN VSS scaling | `canVssScaling` | ratio | 0.5 … 1.5 | Scale the reported vehicle speed value from CAN. Example: Parameter set to 1.1, CAN VSS reports 50kph, ECU will report 55kph instead. |
| Speed Source | `gearDetectionUseOutputShaftSpeed` | choice |  | Driveshaft reference for gear detection. Main Vehicle Speed uses wheel revolutions/km and final drive ratio. Output Shaft Speed reads shaft RPM directly and requires an OSS provider. |
| RPM Source | `gearDetectionRpmSourceIsInputShaftSpeed` | choice |  | RPM source when Speed Source is Output Shaft Speed. Main Vehicle Speed retains automatic input-shaft selection when that sensor is registered. |
| Output Shaft Speed Pin | `outputShaftSpeedSensorPin` | choice |  | Output-shaft pulse input. Leave unassigned for a Lua/CAN provider using Sensor.new("OutputShaftSpeed") in RPM. Use a separate input from the main vehicle speed sensor. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~event_inputs |
| Output Shaft Speed Tooth Count | `outputShaftSpeedSensorTeeth` | count | 1 … 255 | Pulses per output-shaft revolution. |
| Output Shaft Speed Filter | `ossFilterReciprocal` |  | 3 … 200 | Output-shaft low-pass filter reciprocal. Higher values average more teeth. |
| Final drive ratio | `finalGearRatio` | ratio | 0 … 10 | Ratio between the wheels and your transmission output. |
| Forward gear count | `totalGearsCount` |  | 1 … 10 |  |

| Slip Detection | `transmissionSlipDetectionEnabled` | choice |  | Compare the selected Slip RPM Source with expected RPM for the detected gear. Requires Speed Source = Output Shaft Speed, a valid gear and the minimum vehicle speed. Wheel-based references cannot identify transmission slip. |
| Slip RPM Source | `transmissionSlipRpmSourceIsInputShaftSpeed` | choice |  | Input Shaft Speed measures internal gearbox slip. Engine RPM also includes clutch or torque-converter slip. Accurate gear ratios are required. |
